description: Rank credit unions on any metric (e.g. largest by assets, highest return on assets, lowest new auto loan rate, best capitalized), nationally or within a state, peer group or asset range. Ratio rankings exclude very small credit unions by default (each metric has a minimum asset size).

metric.description: Metric key from list_metrics, e.g. assets, roa, nwr, rateNewAuto, memberGrowth.

min_assets.description: Minimum total assets in dollars. Defaults to the metric's ranking minimum.

order.description: "best" follows the metric's direction; size metrics rank highest first.

peer_group.description: NCUA asset-size peer group 1 (under $2M) to 6 ($500M and up).

name: rank_credit_unions
title: Rank credit unions
